text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by enemies, Carrotman is in a dire pinch!
And who should appear just in the nick of time—?!

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
As your best friend and an ally of justice,
Radishman has arrived to back you up, buddy!!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, my friend!! Here we go!
Friendship Mix-Vegetable Slaaaash!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAH!!
A best buddy rushing in during a pinch! Man, that's so passionate!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A best friend and a sidekick, huh...
I wonder who my Radishman would be—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be Bono, no doubt!
She's super kind, big-hearted, and has the soul of justice!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If Bono was a hero, what kind of finishing move would she have?
She loves sweets and chanko, so it's gotta be—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Sweets Chanko Flash"!
Sounds great~, hearty and super strong♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! That'll make the villain stagger,
and then my "Pegasus Attack" will deliver the final blow!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I even thought up our intro speech and poses!
Listen, first you put your arms like this—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Our training yesterday was in total sync!
Just what I'd expect from me and Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Today we're gonna polish it to perfection!
Heyyy! Bono~—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
What?! You couldn't go to the Sweets Festival?!
Even though you were looking forward to it so much!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I had other plans yesterday, you see~.
But it's okay, totally fine! I'm sure they'll hold another one someday♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Sweets... Festival...? What does that mean?
When we were practicing moves yesterday, she didn't mention anything...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
But come on~, didn't you say you also missed
going to watch your favorite sumo wrestler last weekend?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, had something really important I couldn't skip~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Last weekend too, the two of us watched a hero show
and went to Carrotman's handshake event...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono...

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the hallway, I found Biko Pegasus standing there looking like she was about to burst into tears.
When I asked what was wrong—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—So, maybe she put me first
and held back on doing the stuff she really loves.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause Bono never complains, did I...
end up taking advantage of her kindness...?
choice_data_list: Should you ask someone else, then?
Only she knows how she really feels.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No way, I don't want that!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Bono's face immediately popped into my head!
Hero training, taste-testing new chanko recipes,
and so many other things we've done together...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If I was burdening her, I wanna make things equal!
I wanna do more of what Bono likes together with her,
and then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Be heroes who are truly best friends and partners...!
choice_data_list: Sounds like you already have your answer.
Sounds like you already have your answer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Telling her that all she lacked was courage,
Biko Pegasus's eyes widened in realization.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Courage...
Courage is... the most important thing for a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
...If I'm a hero, I gotta summon my courage!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Thank you, Biko-chan.
For gathering your courage and telling me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But you know?
Hanging out with you, Biko-chan,
is just as much fun for me as sweets or sumo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even with that special move yesterday, knowing you
made it while thinking of me made me super happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...So, won't you let me do it?
Be your best friend and hero partner, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono...! Yeah, of course!!
My partner has gotta be Bono, no one else!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: Afterwards—the sight of the two doing their hero training together shone dazzlingly bright.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's true, but...
choice_data_list: Are you just going to take what others said at face value?
Are you just going to take what others said at face value?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
Without even hearing what Bono thinks, that's just...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Doing that... is wrong.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What matters most is how Bono feels.
I've gotta... go make sure.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...It's scary, but I wanna know how
Bono really feels! And if hanging out with me
is actually fun for her, then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Thank you, Biko-chan.
For coming to ask how I felt.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But you know?
Hanging out with you, Biko-chan,
is just as much fun for me as sweets or sumo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even with that special move yesterday, knowing you
made it while thinking of me made me super happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...So, won't you let me do it?
Be your best friend and hero partner, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're more than welcome!!
Ah, but—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm definitely joining in
on the stuff you love too, Bono!!
